title: Repertoire and keys with the Marshall band
summary: The group played blues and tunes like Shine and Chinatown, My Chinatown, mostly in C, B flat and F.

bands.name: Sonny Marshall and his Harlem Stompers

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: But now, you -- when you were working in this band with Sonny Marshall, and you were playing around at these dances and stuff, did you -- do you remember what kind of repertoire you all -- you all had, what tunes, what some of the tunes were you were playing, like standards or originals (unintelligible)

Oh, a lot of blues and -- and, of course, you know, like "Shine" maybe. I don't know -- a lot of tunes that I can't remember of that time. It's hard to remember right now. But I kept up with them, sure, whatever they did. "Chinatown, My Chinatown," "Charleston," and I can't remember some of those things. It's really weird.
Well, that's a long time. I just wanted, you know, general -- did you -- how many key -- did you all play in many keys or did you play on (inaudible)?
They played -- yes, we played in maybe at least three keys, standard, you know, C --
B flat, and then F, yeah, mostly, you know.
